about_the_game:
THE FUTURE OF GAMING IS YOURS

Flair is the first-ever top-down RPG where your imagination literally becomes reality. Forget limits. Forget predefined quests. Here, you create everything. Your hero, your weapons, your home, and even the world itself.

KEY FEATURES

  • Be anyone – Rockstar, alien, president, or something never seen before. No rules. Just creativity.

  • Build anything – Claim land and drop your dream creations into a living, shared, infinite online world.

  • Forge your destiny – Design weapons and gear with purpose—every choice matters in battle.

  • Play together – Explore, team up, or compete in PvE & PvP as the world expands with every player’s ideas.

THE VISION

This isn’t just a game, it’s the next era of interactive entertainment.

  • Every imagination matters: The world grows with your creations.

  • Community-driven: Players don’t just play, they build the future together.

The first RPG where everything is possible. Your creativity fuels the universe. Your ideas shape its future.

Wishlist now and join the beginning of gaming history.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: ntel Core i3 / Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000a
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1/M2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 555X / Apple M1/M2 GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
